import urllib.request
import json

def get_ncbi_gene_info(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={gene_symbol}[Gene+Name]+AND+Homo+sapiens[Organism]&retmode=json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as response:
        search_data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    gene_id = search_data['esearchresult']['idlist'][0]
    
    summary_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(summary_url) as response:
        sum_data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    return sum_data['result'][gene_id]

jarid2_ncbi = get_ncbi_gene_info("JARID2")
lrrc32_ncbi = get_ncbi_gene_info("LRRC32")

print("JARID2 description:", jarid2_ncbi.get('description'))
print("JARID2 genomic:", jarid2_ncbi.get('genomicinfo'))

print("LRRC32 description:", lrrc32_ncbi.get('description'))
print("LRRC32 genomic:", lrrc32_ncbi.get('genomicinfo'))

# Let's check RefSeq mRNA lengths
import urllib.request
import json

def get_refseq_transcripts(gene_id):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/elink.fcgi?dbfrom=gene&db=nuccore&id={gene_id}&term=srcdb+refseq[prop]+AND+mrna[filter]&retmode=json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as response:
        data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    linkset = data['linksets'][0]
    id_list = linkset.get('linksetdbs', [{}])[0].get('links', [])
    
    summary_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=nuccore&id={','.join(id_list[:5])}&retmode=json"
    with urllib.request.urlopen(summary_url) as response:
        sum_data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    return [(v.get('caption'), v.get('slen'), v.get('title')) for k, v in sum_data['result'].items() if k != 'uids']

print("JARID2 RefSeq:", get_refseq_transcripts(3720))
print("LRRC32 RefSeq:", get_refseq_transcripts(2615))
